Dance hen parties

A private dance party for you and your hens, with choreography to your chosen song or theme.

Learn a routine inspired by your favourite pop star or choose a song you enjoy. All ages and dance abilities are welcome, and no experience is needed.

What we offer

  • A private dance party for your group.
  • Choreography to your chosen song or theme.
  • A professional, friendly dance instructor.
  • A session suitable for all ages and dance abilities.

Prices & enquiries

Contact us for prices and availability. Let us know your preferred date, group size and any song or theme ideas.
